_readme: Running jokes the hosts can call back to. Edit freely — keep it to banter about fantasy decisions, nothing personal. Facts (scores, odds, players) never come from here; they come from the sims. 'waste' lines play when that manager has the most games stuck on the bench. 'fanOf' players trigger a line when they're on the OTHER team in that manager's matchup.

Bizzle.waste: And he built the model that's telling him this. Physician, heal thyself.

Danna.waste: Too busy watching Lakers highlights to set a lineup.

Mamba.waste: And this is the only manager in the league who actually reads the rankings!

Slav.waste: Classic Slav. Set the lineup in October, check back in March.
